criteria.label: O1
criteria.description: Variant in a well-curated somatic oncogenic database (canonical oncogenic). Standalone Oncogenic.
criteria.pre_compute_hint: ClinVar somatic (likely) oncogenic or COSMIC/OncoKB canonical

criteria.label: O2
criteria.description: Null variant (frameshift, nonsense, essential splice) in TSG with LOF mechanism
criteria.pre_compute_hint: Frameshift, stop_gained, or canonical splice in known TSG

criteria.label: O3
criteria.description: Absent or very rare in population databases (gnomAD somatic)

criteria.label: O4
criteria.description: Recurrence in somatic databases (COSMIC, GENIE) above expected background

criteria.label: O5
criteria.description: Variant at a known somatic mutational hotspot

criteria.label: O6
criteria.description: Computational evidence supports oncogenic effect (REVEL, CADD, or similar)

criteria.label: O7
criteria.description: Well-established functional study shows oncogenic effect

criteria.label: O8
criteria.description: Missense in a region with known oncogenic missense mechanism

criteria.label: O9
criteria.description: Variant in cancer predisposition gene, found in tumour

criteria.label: O10
criteria.description: Found in cancer type consistent with gene-disease association

criteria.label: O11
criteria.description: Reported as somatic in literature (single case report, unvalidated)

criteria.label: B1
criteria.description: High frequency in population databases (germline polymorphism). Standalone Benign.
criteria.pre_compute_hint: gnomAD AF > 0.01 in any major population

criteria.label: B2
criteria.description: Variant forces VUS classification regardless of score (e.g. uncertain functional significance). Manual only.

criteria.label: B3
criteria.description: Computational evidence supports benign effect (REVEL ≤ 0.4 or low SpliceAI)

criteria.label: B4
criteria.description: Elevated germline frequency above moderate threshold

criteria.label: B5
criteria.description: Well-established functional study shows no oncogenic effect

criteria.label: B6
criteria.description: Non-recurrent in somatic databases in a gene with known mutational context

criteria.label: B7
criteria.description: Classified as benign/likely benign in reputable somatic database

combination_rules.message: O1 is standalone Oncogenic. Other criteria are informational only.
B1 is standalone Benign. Other criteria are informational only.
B2 forces VUS classification regardless of the total score.
O6 and B3 are opposing computational evidence. Only one should be applied.
